narrative:
I called France dangerous but thought our defensive structure could hold them to a share of the spoils — the 3-1 scoreline says that was wishful thinking dressed up as analysis. What I got right is that Les Bleus would score; what I got badly wrong is that I underestimated their ability to break us down repeatedly once they found their rhythm. I leaned on the idea that a disciplined mid-block would frustrate their build-up, but France's individual quality — particularly in the final third — overwhelmed a Lions of Teranga backline that simply couldn't cope at this level for 90 minutes. Predicting a draw implied we'd be defensively resolute enough to cancel out their attacking threat, and the -2 goal differential against Les Bleus shows that premise was flawed from the start.
